text:
incident-bot: PAGER: KV cache hit rate below 25% in us-west-2 inference pool for 2m. Severity=P1. Alert: KVCacheLowHitRate. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/kv-hitrate?orgId=1
Sam L: oncall ack, looking. pulling hit-rate, eviction, and pod restarts now.
Sam L: quick query: `avg_over_time(cache.hitrate{pool=\"us-west-2\"}[5m])` shows 18% currently, eviction rate spiked ~00:05 UTC.
Leila (oncall): on my way. Sam do you see backend 503s or increased tail-latency?
Sam L: logs show transient 503s from model-backend-3 and cache evictions jumped (see snippet):
```
cache.evictions_total{pool=\"us-west-2\"}  =  1243
cache.hitrate{pool=\"us-west-2\"} = 0.18
```
Mike H: ran `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` — 2 restarts on cache-shard-5 in last 10m, oomkilled once.
Sam L: I'm going to scale the cache pool by +2 replicas and temporarily enable permissive eviction-suppression for canaries.
Leila (oncall): please add mitigation steps to thread. I'll notify support. @Support Bot can you create an incident record and message affected customers?
Support Bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created. Notifying customer BrightTravel (account id: acct_bright). Status: investigating.
Sam L: scaled cache -> `kubectl scale deploy/cache-pool-usw2 --replicas=6 -n inference`. Also bumped memory on cache-shard-5 to avoid OOM.
Nora S: got it. Can you paste the command you used to change eviction policy?
Sam L: changed config map `cache-config` : `eviction.policy=lfu; eviction.squelch=false` -> temporarily set `eviction.squelch=true` for canaries. Command: `kubectl patch cm cache-config -n inference --patch '{"data":{"eviction.squelch":"true"}}'`
Mike H: after scaling and squelch, hit rate climbed to ~68% in 7m. Latency back to normal for BrightTravel.
Leila (oncall): Good. I'll stay on this for the next 30m and then hand to Nora. Sam, we should discuss alert tuning — this one paged at 25% over 2m which is noisy during autoscaling.
Sam L: +1. Proposed changes: increase alert `for` to 10m, change threshold to 15% for pager and keep 25% for slack-only. Also add eviction-rate alert (evictions > 50/min) to page.
Nora S: also: add per-shard hit-rate panels and a global aggregated hit-rate with rolls by model-variant. Right now graphs are too coarse.
Leila (oncall): creating a follow-up ticket for dashboard + alert changes. Ticket infra-ops#842.
Sam L: quick draft of new alert rule YAML to discuss:
```
- alert: KVCacheLowHitRate
  expr: avg_over_time(cache.hitrate{pool=\"us-west-2\"}[5m]) < 0.15
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: slack
- alert: KVCacheLowHitRatePager
  expr: avg_over_time(cache.hitrate[pool=\"us-west-2\"][10m]) < 0.12
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: pager
- alert: KVCacheHighEvictionRate
  expr: increase(cache.evictions_total[5m]) > 50
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: pager
```
Nora S: recommend adding `job=~"cache.*"` label scoping and excluding maintenance windows via silence. Also add `team=eng-oncall` annotation.
Mike H: can we also add a squelch that prevents paging for capacity-autoscale events? We see bursts when autoscaler resizes. Maybe tie to `autoscaler.activity` metric.
Leila (oncall): good idea. Add silence condition when `autoscaler.active=true` for 10m after scaling events. We'll run a 2-week test before permanent change.
Sam L: created temp dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-hit-review/kv-hit-rate (panels: per-shard hit, eviction rate, pod restarts, model fallback ratio).
Support Bot: Customer BrightTravel notified: automated message sent 2026-03-14T00:12Z. They reported degraded latency affecting search results, but confirm resolution now.
Leila (oncall): handoff to Nora in 30m — Nora, can you own follow-ups: ticket infra-ops#842, update playbook, and schedule 1h review with runtime team tomorrow?
Nora S: taking handoff. I'll run post-incident RCA and include root cause (OOM on cache-shard-5 + aggressive eviction config) and proposed changes: increase pod memory by 20%, add eviction-rate page, tune thresholds as above, create runbook snippet.
Sam L: adding short-term change: pin model fallback to current variant for 24h to avoid extra cache churn.
Leila (oncall): thanks team. Action items: [infra-ops#842] dashboard + alerts, runbook update, schedule review, customer follow-up. Marking incident as RESOLVED (mitigated) for now. :white_check_mark:
Nora S: will post a brief postmortem in #postmortems by EOD with links to graphs.
Sam L: leaving a note in the config repo: `docs/cache/README.md` — explain squelch flag and when to use.
Leila (oncall): closing the pager. If it reoccurs after changes, reopen. Great coordination everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-045
